arxiv-2008-08398.title: On CCZ-equivalence of the inverse function
arxiv-2008-08398.creator: Lukas Kölsch
arxiv-2008-08398.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Lukas Kölsch. The inverse function x ↦ x − 1 x\mapsto x^{-1} on 𝔽 2 n \mathbb{F}_{2^{n}} is one of the most studied functions in cryptography due to its widespread use as an S-box in block ciphers like AES. In this paper, we show that, if n ≥ 5 n\geq 5 , every function that is CCZ-equivalent to the inverse function is already EA-equivalent to it. This confirms a conjecture by Budaghyan, Calderini and Villa.

arxiv-2309-11996.description: Abstract The precision in reconstructing events detected in a dual-phase time projection chamber depends on an homogeneous and well understood electric field within the liquid target.
